biography.value:
Slann Mage-Priest. A caster presence from the Lizardmen, built for brutal, legible table play. Its numbers are recalibrated from a PF2e-style creature benchmark and mapped back onto D&D challenge expectations.

Rules Profile. AC 18; HP 222; proficiency +6; save DC 21. Linked armory entries: 16. Linked spell entries: 3.

"A warrior is measured when the line begins to break."
- Old World battlefield saying

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e

Шторм стрел [Arrow Storm]. Шторм стрел [Arrow Storm] tears shape from the Winds of Magic and forces it into a weaponized moment: bright, cold, hungry, or cruel according to the lore that birthed it.

Mechanics. Casting uses action at range self spec. Targets make a Intelligence saving throw against the caster's spell save DC; on a failed save, apply its listed activity damage.

"Victory belongs to the hand that does not tremble at dusk."
- Old World magister
